raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "physical units of the 2 by 1 domain",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 gives dimensions 2 by 1 without length units. Appendix A supplies dimensional units for Young's modulus.",
      "readings": [
        "2 m by 1 m",
        "2 mm by 1 mm",
        "A nondimensional 2 by 1 domain"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The two-dimensional formulation in Secs. 2.4 and 3.1 does not specify thickness or a per-unit-depth convention.",
      "readings": [
        "Unit thickness",
        "Uniform thickness of 0.01 length units",
        "Report compliance and volume per unit out-of-plane depth"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "load at the bottom-right corner",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Secs. 4.1 and 4.2 establish the nominal corner location, but neither specifies whether the force is concentrated or spread over a boundary patch, its patch length, or its distribution. Fig. 6 is unavailable.",
      "readings": [
        "A concentrated nodal force at the bottom-right corner",
        "Uniform traction over the lowest one-element segment of the right edge",
        "Uniform traction over the lowest 0.1 of the right-edge height",
        "Linearly tapered traction over the lowest 0.1 of the right-edge height"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "bottom-right load",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 and the Fig. 6 caption do not state the force direction or its components.",
      "readings": [
        "Vertical downward",
        "Horizontal rightward",
        "Diagonal downward and rightward with equal components"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "bottom-right load",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No resultant force or traction magnitude is supplied. Sec. 3.1's solid-design normalization cancels a common nonzero load multiplier.",
      "readings": [
        "Resultant force of 1 N",
        "Resultant force of 10 N",
        "Unit resultant in nondimensional units"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "material around the load and support",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 3.1 and 4.1 do not explicitly identify an in-domain passive mask. Appendix B's exterior solid extension for counting holes does not establish whether interior attachment elements are held solid.",
      "readings": [
        "All in-domain elements are designable",
        "The loaded corner element is held solid",
        "One-element solid attachment pads are imposed at both the load and support"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "volume bound for a minimum-compliance rerun",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 maps multiple branches rather than prescribing one volume-constrained problem. Its c_max = 5 and reported volume coordinates do not select a unique epsilon_v. The bound is explicitly on dilated volume.",
      "readings": [
        "Dilated volume fraction at most 0.45",
        "Dilated volume fraction at most 0.70",
        "Dilated volume fraction at most 0.77"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Poisson ratio",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Sec. 3.3 states that the numerical examples use nu = 1/3; Appendix A states that all experiments use nu = 0.3.",
      "readings": [
        "nu = 1/3",
        "nu = 0.3"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "two-dimensional elastic constitutive model",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 specifies linear elasticity and Appendix A specifies isotropic material, but neither selects plane stress or plane strain.",
      "readings": [
        "Plane stress",
        "Plane strain"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "filter radius and projection steepness",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Table 1 gives R/h = 25 for Sec. 4.1. Appendix A fixes beta = 10 while asserting beta = R/(3h) or R/(5h), which instead requires R/h = 30 or 50.",
      "readings": [
        "Keep Table 1's R/h = 25 and Appendix A's beta = 10",
        "Keep beta = 10 and enforce beta = R/(3h), giving R/h = 30",
        "Keep beta = 10 and enforce beta = R/(5h), giving R/h = 50",
        "Keep R/h = 25 and enforce beta = R/(3h), giving beta = 25/3",
        "Keep R/h = 25 and enforce beta = R/(5h), giving beta = 5"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "conversion of reported radius to the PDE coefficient",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Appendix A mentions rescaling by sqrt(3), but supplies neither the PDE nor an explicit before/after definition of Table 1's R.",
      "readings": [
        "For -ell^2 Laplacian(q) + q = x, use ell = R/sqrt(3)",
        "Use ell = R because the reported radius already incorporates the conversion",
        "For the same PDE, use ell = sqrt(3) R"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "PDE-filter boundary conditions",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 cites consistent boundary conditions without equations. Appendix B identifies Robin neighborhoods near loaded and fixed boundaries, but does not give their coefficients or the filter conditions on the remaining boundaries.",
      "readings": [
        "On those neighborhoods impose q + ell times its outward normal derivative = 1; use zero flux elsewhere",
        "On those neighborhoods impose q + 2 ell times its outward normal derivative = 1; use zero flux elsewhere",
        "Use the first Robin condition near attachments and impose q = 0 on the remaining boundaries"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "smoothed Heaviside projection function",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 supplies the projection thresholds and Appendix A supplies beta, but the projection function itself is only cited. Its mathematical definition is absent from the supplied text.",
      "readings": [
        "Endpoint-normalized tanh projection using tanh(beta times (q - eta))",
        "Endpoint-normalized logistic projection using 1/(1 + exp(-beta times (q - eta)))"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "PDE-filter discretization",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 assigns design variables to elements but does not specify how the PDE filter is discretized or how element densities are transferred to and from a nodal filter field.",
      "readings": [
        "Nodal finite-element Helmholtz filter with a consistent mass matrix and element-node averaging",
        "Nodal finite-element Helmholtz filter with a lumped mass matrix",
        "Cell-centered finite-volume Helmholtz filter acting directly on element densities"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "stiffness integration for square first-order elements",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 fixes square first-order elements and Table 1 fixes their counts, but the stiffness quadrature and any stabilization are not specified.",
      "readings": [
        "Four-node bilinear quadrilaterals with full 2 by 2 Gauss integration",
        "Four-node bilinear quadrilaterals with one-point integration and hourglass stabilization"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "candidate grid and puncture locations for nonzero-hole branches",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 locates the first hole only on the fixed left edge and does not locate the second. Appendix B's center-left traversal does not give exact candidate coordinates or resolve the two central element rows of the 200 by 100 mesh. Fig. 8 illustrates a different, symmetric R/h = 15 setup.",
      "readings": [
        "Generate the candidate grid from the lower central element row, y/l_y = 0.495, proceeding rightward first",
        "Generate the candidate grid from the upper central element row, y/l_y = 0.505, proceeding rightward first"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "minimum feature size and puncture radius",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 3.3 describes a hole diameter b_min, whereas Appendix B uses a minimum-length-scale quantity r_min directly as a radius. Their relation and the cited calculation are not supplied. Fig. 8's numerical length scale belongs to R/h = 15 rather than Sec. 4.1.",
      "readings": [
        "Scale Fig. 8's 0.095 by 25/15 and interpret it as a diameter: puncture radius approximately 0.07917 l_y",
        "Scale Fig. 8's 0.095 by 25/15 and interpret it as Appendix B's radius: puncture radius approximately 0.15833 l_y"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "acceptance rule for hole nucleation",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Sec. 3.3 requires punctures to increase genus. Appendix B instead says a puncture is accepted only if it does not change topology.",
      "readings": [
        "Accept a puncture only when it increases the hole count",
        "Accept a puncture only when the hole count remains unchanged",
        "Interpret Appendix B as preserving solid connectivity while allowing the hole count to increase"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "strictness and role of the compliance ceiling",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Equation 5 requires c < c_max, but the volume-minimization scalarization permits c <= epsilon_c <= c_max and Sec. 4.1 reports endpoints at c = 5.",
      "readings": [
        "Enforce c < 5 and exclude the equality endpoint",
        "Enforce c <= 5 and retain equality endpoints",
        "Use 5 as a tracing cutoff, with no separate compliance constraint in individual minimum-compliance solves"
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "operational definition of convergence",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Appendix A gives stopping thresholds and iteration windows, but does not identify the KKT-residual norm, whether residual change means change of its norm or norm of its vector change, or a numerical constraint-feasibility tolerance.",
      "readings": [
        "Euclidean residual norm, absolute change of that norm, and exact nonpositive constraint residuals",
        "Maximum-component residual norm, absolute change of that norm, and constraint tolerance 1e-6",
        "Euclidean residual norm, Euclidean norm of the residual-vector change, and constraint tolerance 1e-6"
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    }
  ]
}
